# Erdos.p291 — Erdős problem 291

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/291
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/291.lean`, theorem `erdos_291.variants.shiu_heuristic_asymptotic`, AMS 11).

This leads to a heuristic prediction (see for example a preprint of Shiu [Sh16]) of
$\asymp\frac{x}{\log x}$ for the number of $n\in [1,x]$ such that $(a_n,L_n)=1$.

## Statement
Asymptotics.IsTheta atTop
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ ((((Finset.Icc 1 x).filter (fun n ↦ Nat.gcd (a n) (L n) = 1)).card : ℝ)))
      (fun x : ℕ ↦ (x : ℝ) / Real.log x)

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
